sprints.name: Aurora Sprint 24
sprints.goal: Fix the Aurora reconnect status for the Lakeshore Retail pilot and keep the November 20 status-service cutover safe. Available capacity before the Friday, November 20, 15:00 checkpoint: 32 team-hours.

issues.summary: Rollout regression checks for the status-service cutover
issues.description:
Run the rollout regression checks on the event-driven status service before the November 20 cutover.

Required for a safe cutover.

issues.summary: Aurora hubs remain offline after reconnect
issues.description:
Lakeshore Retail pilot hubs remain Offline in the dashboard after a successful network reconnect. Telemetry resumes, but staff restart working devices because the visible state is stale. Pilot expansion is November 23.

**Acceptance criteria**

- Reconnected pilot devices show Online on the active service.
- Automated new-service reconnect coverage.
- No regression in existing reconnect behaviour.

comments.author: triin
comments.body: I have started working on the fix.
